revisionDesc.change: Finalized - done
Vote - AcceptText - I agree with all the remarks of the first voter. The date of the papyrus should be reconsidered (it's earlier in my view).
General - lin8: I agree with the previous voter. I see the two nys, but the second one was ovoverwritten by the chi.

Vote - AcceptText - Some excellent PN readings, one of them important. — lin2 is indented; εὖ (CB) is clear (not [ε]ὖ), but it will be tricky to encode it. || lin8 I don't see <:ἡ|subst|ν:> but χ written over να. || lin11 punctuate after πέμψον. | πεζῇ̣ looks acceptable but what to do with ἀνὰ ὄνον later? He will other go on foot or ride a donkey. || lin13 => \δη/λῶσαί || lin16 => κοινωνούς|reg|κυνωνούς | => |ed|δώσω̣σι <:π̣άλιν|reg|π̣άλι:> τὰ:> (i.e. move τὰ inside the corrected part) || lin17 δὲ => δέ || lin 18 check τράχει > τάχει || lin21 [ν]α̣υαρχίας̣ is fine || lin27 τῆς fine || lin30 fine.
Submit - Integration of BL 7 corrections and A. Papathomas' corrections in CdE 84 (2009). New corrections.
Commit - Also l. 16 δώσω̣σι π̣άλι (l. πάλιν) => δώσω̣σιν̣ ὀλίγα̣

Commit - I've integrated BL 7 and A. Papathomas' corrections in CdE 84 (2009) [I omitted his correction in l. 26, where he reads τοῖς instead of τῆς). Further corrections: in l. 1a. [ε]ὖ πράττειν => εὖ πράττειν; l. 10 πεδῖ (l. πεζῇ) => πεζῇ̣ (the papyrus has a zeta and a partially abraded eta); l. 14 κεφαλαιωτίαν => <:κεφαλαιωτίαν|subst|κεφαλαιωτ\ει̣/:>; l. 26 τὸ τῆ̣ς [το]ῦ <:ἀρχείου|reg|ἀρχίο̣υ̣:> φρόντισμα => τὸ τῆς [ν]α̣υαρχίας̣ φρόντισμα (the office of the commander of the fleet), which opens exciting new ways of interpretation; l. 29 I've disagreed with BL 7 οὐκ εὑρὼν, as I see οὐκ εὗρον with an omicron.
Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Fine.
l15: added reg to π̣άλι => <:π̣άλιν|reg|π̣άλι:> I prefer this solution over π̣άλι<ν>
